heap_reset now zeroes [mark, bump) before the rewind, through a
dedicated preamble fn (never inline - the callers' scratch locals
may be live). The post-reset world is bit-identical to the
never-allocated world, so every zero-read in the runtime -
slot_present's Option niche, the unwritten make_list slots that
alloc_list_sc leaves untouched - stays true under reuse. The
invariant had held by the accident of monotonicity: wasm's
zero-initialized pages made unwritten slots read zero only because
memory was never reused, and the first reuse served stale bytes as
placed argument slots. Under the contract the regioned battery runs
at a 192MB peak.

The battery ships no-reset still: the twelve-kill forensic corpus
ends at a standing frontier the virgin reset does not clear - the
fill_arg_slots slots buffer aliases the env handler's own state in
virgin memory, both gated hits at collect's placed arm and zero at

mentl/0543b48:
The bank Ruling 4. A MultiShot arm's resume-with-state no longer
floors: the commit prefix — the resume value and every update RHS
snapshot against the arm's PRE-update state into per-site locals, then
the slot stores commit — factors whole out of lower_resume_snapshot
into resume_commit_prefix, one builder with two tails. OneShot returns
the snapshotted value (LReturn; the produced LowIR is byte-identical by
construction). MultiShot commits BEFORE the k-call — the stores write
through the arm's __state, which IS the install record the driver
pushed, and arm state reads are live LUpval loads through that record,
so the resumed remainder and the next resume in the same arm both see
committed state — and the k-call takes the SNAPSHOTTED val local, never
a re-lower after the stores (the ev8d 58-not-57 race).

gates — 30/36/40/29/26/16 held, mn-arm-state-multishot=46 on the first
run (s=10: snapshot 10, commit 17, k(10)=11; live 17, k(17)=18;
11+18+17 — a val re-lowered after the stores computes 53, never 46).
The cross-commit byte gate, the one M1 item the m2==m3 ratchet cannot
arbitrate (both generations run the same changed compiler): the
pre-M1.5 m2 and the rebuilt m2 compile mn-resume-splice, mn-ev5, and
mn-ev16 to byte-identical outputs — the prefix factor is pure on the

mentl/05bdbcd:
ide/serve.mn is an HTTP/1.1 file server written in Mentl, compiled by
the fixpoint compiler, speaking the WASI socket substrate
(lib/runtime/net.mn: poll_oneoff-blocked sock_accept over the listener
wasmtime preopens with -S tcplisten; connections are plain fds through
fd_read/fd_write). Every response carries the COOP/COEP pair the IDE's
shared-memory compiler requires — the reason serve.py existed, now a
Mentl truth. The accept loop is an evidence-threading tail call:
constant stack for the server's whole life.

find_listener reads the preopen table for the socket and fs_dir_fd
reads it for the directory — the fd order is the host invocation's
business, never a baked constant. serve.sh compiles-if-stale with
boot/mentl.wasm and hands wasmtime the invocation: a scaffold that
dissolves at the mentl serve verb. serve.py is deleted; no python
remains in the run path (tools/emit-diff.py stays as a debugging
instrument, named for dissolution into mentl diff).

Battle-tested: 200 with byte-identical bodies (index + the 1.9MB
compiler wasm through the partial-write loop), isolation headers on
every response, 404/403 clean, 30 sequential requests green. PLAN
banks the ultimate form: Hβ.emit.image-map-fold (the module layout as
ONE fold — also band B's persist substrate: it defines what a memcpy
snapshot means), Hβ.io.scratch-dissolves-into-alloc, and

empirical):

1. Generic type application — `Name<T1, T2, ...>` per SYNTAX.md:147.
   parse_type_ty's TIdent arm now checks for TLt after the name; if
   present, parse_type_args parses comma-separated type args terminated

   Option<String>)` no longer fires `expected )<`.

   lists.mn). Tuple/record subscript dispatch is post-L1 via infer
   narrowing the receiver's type; substrate-honest because the parser
